2187-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2187-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1021-1315-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

3764-5330-7924.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the Clue.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

1479-2841-6528-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6528-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

433-2137-7857.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery
433-2137-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control two lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce mana.
433-2137-7857.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand for which legal target(s) exist, if applicable.
433-2137-7857.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control from the battlefield to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery spell.
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout
Repeat steps 3 and 4 one additional time.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-2897.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-2897.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Evil Twin and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-2897.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2713-4866-7426-7737.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2713-4866-7426-7737.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Zirda and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2100-7420.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}
Molten-Core Maestro triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

5414-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-4985-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4985-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

789-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
789-6798-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

3525-3755-4028.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {U}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1322-1719-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

465-719-3742-4251-7060.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

911-4050-6972--112.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
911-4050-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

2225-3053-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
2225-3053-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

647-3259--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
647-3259--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

4050-5631-5751-5763.description:
Cast Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1}{G} and discarding a land card.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature token and Circle of the Land Druid, adding {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

856-997-1808-4321.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1636-3143-5696-6174.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5696-6174.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Soul Stair Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Soul Stair Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

1887-2511-3305-4022-5926.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating a token copy of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, the Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and the Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalist trigger, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

643-1636-4241.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
643-1636-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Maskwood Nexus to become a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

654-774-1714-2137.notablePrerequisites:
High Tide in hand.You control at least two basic Islands.
"Blue" chosen with Gauntlet of Power.
654-774-1714-2137.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, activate two basic Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Gauntlet of Power triggers twice, adding {U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two basic Islands to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two basic Islands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Islands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping them.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite {U}, you may instead use any other lands you control to get infinite mana those lands produce.

2034-2146-3321-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Filigree Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
When Filigree Familiar dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Filigree Familiar on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Filigree Familiar trigger, causing you to draw Filigree Familiar.
Cast Filigree Familiar by paying {2}.
When Filigree Familiar enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2034-2210-2661-2895.notablePrerequisites: Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
708-2034-2210-2661-2895.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {G}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Uro from the command zone by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping itself.
Uro enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Uro, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Uro to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirrormade each trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, causing you to not sacrifice Uro due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain three life, draw a card, and put any land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2187-4377-4702.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons getting an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Activate Possessed Skaab, by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
The token copy of Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
